action: Lead with supported claim: double-wall vacuum keeps coffee hot 6 hours and cold drinks cold 12 hours, with ceramic interior that does not change coffee taste.
Show an upside-down sealed tumbler photo plus a short car-cup-holder clip proving the bamboo slide lid stays closed.
State 400 ml capacity and that it fits most car cup holders, aimed at single-serve commute coffee.
Position TT-400 at $26 as the commute tumbler that delivers multi-hour heat without Yeti pricing.
FAQ: hand-wash only; explain how to slide and rinse the bamboo closure, and warn against dishwasher use that damages coatings on competitors.
Make the bamboo slide removable without tools so the seal can be cleaned, addressing trapped-residue complaints.
Add a small vent path in the slide so liquid pours without the trickle users report on sealed slider lids.
Offer a finish-and-handle warranty covering peeling and breakage, since coating and handle failures drive returns on competitors.
Publish a drop/handle stress photo of the travel handle, since broken handles are a distinct complaint on handled tumblers.
Call out the 6-hour hot / 12-hour cold spec next to the ceramic-coated interior so longer hold is a concrete claim, not a wish.
